name: harness-knowledge
description: Binds a stateless Copilot CLI control harness to its private knowledge repo, harness-first: clone the harness, then this plugin asks for (or creates) the knowledge repo, writes the machine-local knowledge_repo pointer, registers both repos, and assembles a machine-local instructions fragment labeling the concrete harness/knowledge/product paths -- so the shareable harness tree stays generic and name-free. Ships the binding-knowledge setup skill.
